_about: Diamond & Pearl through Call of Legends English Theme Decks, researched 2026-11-26: 35 decks (dp1 3, dp2 2, dp3 2, dp4 3, dp5 2, dp6 2, dp7 2, pl1 2, pl2 2, pl3 2, pl4 2 [Arceus], hgss1 3, hgss2 2, hgss3 2, hgss4 2, col1 2). The set a deck is filed under is the expansion Bulbapedia names (Platinum: Arceus decks are pl4). All 34 lists total exactly 60. Sources: (1) Bulbapedia deck pages '<Deck> (TCG)' via the MediaWiki API; (2) German pokewiki.de deck pages (Kartenliste with set+number, all 35); (3) Serebii https://serebii.net/card/themedeck/<deck>.shtml for the 22 DP and Platinum-block decks it covers (no HGSS/CoL pages; Serebii's quantity of the final rows is misparsed for Eternal Time, Overflow and Rebellion, and the Arceus promo row of Flamemaster/Stormshaper is not parsed, so those 5 are bp + pokewiki.de only). Recon also checked by a web-search summary of pokemoncard.io and a retailer list (not fetched directly). Cards resolved against data/<set>.json by (set, number). Disagreements (used value in brackets): Skull Charge energy Bulbapedia 14 Grass/10 Fighting vs pokewiki+Serebii 10/14 [10 Grass/14 Fighting]; Bombardment energy Bulbapedia+Serebii 8 Water/16 Fighting vs pokewiki 13/11 [8/16]; Infinite Space energy Bulbapedia 17 Water/7 Psychic vs pokewiki+Serebii 16/8 [16/8]; Endless Night Bulbapedia+Serebii 2 Energy Search+2 Potion vs pokewiki 4 Energy Search, no Potion [Bulbapedia]; Forest Force Bulbapedia (and a retailer list) 2 Dusk Ball+1 Energy Restore vs pokewiki+Serebii 1+2 [pokewiki/Serebii: 1 Dusk Ball, 2 Energy Restore]; Recon Bulbapedia (and pokemoncard/retailer) 8 Grass/10 Fire vs pokewiki 10/8 [8/10]. Several decks differ only by WHICH PRINT of a reprinted trainer/common (e.g. Potion dp1-118 vs dp3-127, Larvitar hgss2-50 vs 51, Metang dp6-64 vs 65): per-deck notes say which was used (Bulbapedia unless pokewiki and Serebii both agree on the other). Basic Energy: Bulbapedia lists dp2-pl4 deck Energy as unnumbered; pokewiki.de and Serebii both list them as Diamond & Pearl numbered Energy (dp1 123-130 = dp1-123..dp1-130 on the site), so those ids are used (the unnumbered shared print energy-<type>-dp also exists in js/catalog.js ENERGY_PRINTS as 'dp', same art, label 'Diamond & Pearl 2007'; dp1-123..130 chosen because two sources name the numbers). dp1 decks and Inferno Zone/Royal Frost/Terra Firma use dp1 numbered Energy per Bulbapedia too. HGSS decks use hgss1-115..122 (HGSS numbered Energy) and Call of Legends decks col1-88..95, numbers as Bulbapedia lists them (pokewiki.de's col1 energy numbers are wrong, types agree). No shared-id ENERGY_PRINTS ('energy-*') ids are used. SHOWCASE: 'showcase' is the deck's Rare Holo row; Bulbapedia's trivia says which are exclusive holofoil/Cosmos/Cracked Ice prints (all but dp1 decks and Endless Night, Flamemaster, Stormshaper, which carry no exclusive-print note: the deck holo is the pack print). Daybreak, Nightfall etc: the listing shows the holo Espeon and a non-holo Espeon as separate rows of the same card number; merged into one row n=2 (and for Rare-Holo-plus-Rare pairs the two copies are the same site id). TCGplayer: no separate product exists for any deck-exclusive print; showcaseTcgplayerId is the product of the card's normal print (TCGplayer folds the theme holo into the Normal/Reverse Holofoil rows of that product; the site's existing dp2-21-theme / dp2-33-theme reuse the same ids). SEALED TCGplayer: only 14 decks have a product (found by scanning every tcgcsv group): Terra Firma 228804, Inferno Zone 228805, Royal Frost 228806, Skull Charge 229176, Armor Fortress 229177, Polar Frost 229132, Forest Force 229134, Metal Surge 693133, Flourish 229173, Rebellion 229175, Overflow 645310, Stormshaper 678178, Flamemaster 678179, Retort 644851. No product exists for dp3, dp4, dp7 decks, Bombardment, pl2 decks, Ignition, any hgss1-4 deck, or Recon (tcgplayerId null). marketPrice is null for all: TCGplayer lists no market price; Inferno Zone has low/mid 399.99, Stormshaper/Flamemaster 501.00 (noted per deck). Release dates are Bulbapedia's. Extras: HGSS-block (Undaunted, Triumphant) and Call of Legends decks include a booster pack of the set (Bulbapedia); DP/Platinum/Unleashed/HGSS-base decks do not. The real decks hold no extra 61st card.
